ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to restrict the user from editing or creating Rebate Program for Under Revision or Approved Sales Agreement.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c ) , OR( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(Status) , 'Inactive'), AND( ISPICKVAL( Status, 'Inactive'), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.Status , 'Archived'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.Status , 'Expired'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.Status , 'Cancelled') ) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Inactive Rebate Programs cannot be updated.
